thread:
Maria Gomez: quick question — I hit an ambiguous case in the gateway matcher that I want to get consensus on.
Maria Gomez: we have these routes configured:
Maria Gomez: ```
# A
host: "*.example.com"
path: "/api"
service: svc-main

# B
host: "api.example.com"
path: "/api/v2/"
service: svc-v2

# C
host: "*.example.com"
path: "/api/v2"
service: svc-main-v2
```
Maria Gomez: request to Host: `api.example.com`, Path: `/api/v2/health` — which route should win? feels ambiguous.
Chris Patel: my read: exact host match (api.example.com) > wildcard, and longest path match next. so B (svc-v2) should win because host exact + path prefix `/api/v2/` matches.
Samir Khan: agree with host precedence, but trailing slash semantics matter. Our current matcher normalizes paths by trimming duplicate slashes but keeps trailing slash significance for prefix matches.
Samir Khan: example: `/api/v2/` is a prefix of `/api/v2/health` => matches.
Jules: edge: what if someone uses `path: "/api/v2"` (no trailing slash) — should that match `/api/v2/health`? currently yes we treat both as prefix-match with implicit slash boundary unless `exact: true`.
Noah L.: I think we need a deterministic tie-breaker doc: order of precedence = 1) exact host > host wildcard depth (longer literal segments) 2) longest path prefix (count segments) 3) explicit `exact` flag wins over prefix 4) explicit header/host overrides (if set) override default routing.
Maria Gomez: sounds reasonable. but consider service pattern overlap: if svc-main and svc-main-v2 are both compatible, do we prefer same service family as earlier route in config? that would be surprising.
Chris Patel: we should avoid config-order as a tie-breaker unless explicitly called out (e.g., `priority` field). relying on file order is brittle.
Samir Khan: +1. prefer deterministic rules based on metric (host specificity, then path specificity, then explicitness). if still equal, require admin to set `priority` or `weight`.
DevBot: deploy-bot: new matcher change branch created: refs/heads/matcher/hostname-path-precedence
Jules: small nit — host specificity: compare number of literal characters not wildcard count. so `api.prod.example.com` should be more specific than `*.prod.example.com`.
Noah L.: also need to document how header-based overrides interact. e.g., `X-Route-To: svc-experimental` should only supersede if route has `allow_header_override: true` and header set. otherwise it's ignored.
Maria Gomez: good point. propose rule doc snippet:
Maria Gomez: ```
Precedence summary:
1) Host specificity (exact hostname > longer literal > wildcard)
2) Path specificity (more segments / longer literal prefix wins)
3) Explicit match flags (exact:true, method constraints, header constraints)
4) Header-based override (only if route allows overrides)
5) Fallback to configured `priority` numeric if still ambiguous
6) If still ambiguous, reject config at validation time
```
Chris Patel: validation-time rejection is nice — surface misconfig during deploy.
Samir Khan: +emoji :+1: — Also, add examples in the docs with edge cases around trailing slashes and `/*` vs `/` prefix.
Jules: can we also add a small decision table for maintainers? like given host, path, header -> selected route id.
Maria Gomez: yes. I'll draft a PR for docs and an RFC in the repo. will include the exact matching algorithm and pseudo-code.
Noah L.: pseudo-code request — something like:
Noah L.: ```
candidates = routes.filter(matchHost(request.host))
candidates = candidates.filter(matchPathPrefix(request.path))
sort(candidates, by=[host_specificity, path_length, explicit_flags, priority])
winner = candidates[0]
if multiple winners and no priority -> validation error
```
Chris Patel: matches our discussion. one more thing: telemetry — we should emit metric `route_selection.conflicts` on validation failures and `route_selection.fallbacks` when header overrides are used.
Maria Gomez: good call. I'll add telemetry hooks in the RFC.
DevBot: deploy-bot: branch matcher/hostname-path-precedence pushed, CI queued
Samir Khan: thanks — can someone review the matcher change? cc @Chris Patel @Jules
Jules: on it, will take a look this afternoon.
Maria Gomez: thanks team — will open the RFC and link the PR once ready. :pray:
